title: docs: Astro Starlight site + GitHub Pages deploy, and README rewrite
body: ## Summary Adds a documentation site under `docs/` (Astro Starlight) that auto-deploys to GitHub Pages, and rewrites the README from a one-line stub into a real project overview. Docs content is grounded in the actual code (CLI flags from `internal/agentcli` + `cmd/controlplane/admin.go`, RPCs from `pkg/api`, config/env vars from `SECURITY.md` + `cmd/controlplane/main.go`, FIPS from this repo's `GOFIPS140=latest` build). ### Docs site (`docs/`) - Starlight scaffold configured for a **project page**: `site=https://exonical.github.io`, `base=/rootseal` (both overridable via `SITE`/`BASE` env). Pages: Introduction, Quick start, Architecture, Unlock flow, Security model, Installation (RPM), Configuration, Enrollment, TPM attestation, Vault, FIPS 140-3, CLI reference, gRPC API. - `npm run build` produces 15 static pages. All internal cross-page links were verified against the built `dist/` (a depth-aware relative-link script confirmed zero broken links — important because Astro does not auto-prefix `base` onto markdown links). ### Deploy workflow (`.github/workflows/docs.yml`) - Triggers on push to `main` under `docs/**` (and manual dispatch). Uses `withastro/action@v3` to build and `actions/deploy-pages@v4` to publish, with `pages: write` + `id-token: write` permissions. ### README - Replaced the 3-line stub with overview, component table, security highlights, local quick start, build/test, FIPS verification, and a link to the docs site. ## Required one-time repo setting GitHub Pages must be set to **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source: GitHub Actions** for the deploy job to publish. The site will then be live at `https://exonical.github.io/rootseal/`. ## Local preview ![Rootseal docs home](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..wNdrEtt4j6YMKQsklvDox8k_f5M2bMZPtX5VXAoghRo) Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/809a75bcfd14493ea1c78f60d5369cac Requested by: @Exonical ---
